mathematical_root_cause: The 60-minute recording duration minus 20-minute window length establishes an absolute theoretical maximum lead time of 40.0 minutes before delivery (T_delivery - T_prediction <= 40.0 min). Consequently, evaluation horizons >=60m and >=45m evaluate the exact same earliest available prediction (at T=40.0m) across all 547 patients, guaranteeing mathematically identical AUROC (0.5360).
